paired_schematic.recommended_visible_note: U15 physical 1 (IO1) is the RX clamp; physical 2 (IO2) is the TX clamp. NC10 carries RX and NC9 carries TX on the upstream connector side as external board copper lands only. Board copper joins 10-1 and separately 9-2. NC lands have no internal conduction or clamp function. IO3/IO4 and NC6/NC7 remain unused.

expected_content.method: Native KiCad copper polygons: tracks/vias/pads ERROR_OUTSIDE, actual clamp pad ERROR_INSIDE, maximum polygon error 0.00001 mm. Subtract only actual clamp pad copper from every copper object on the actual clamp pad layer(s), split resulting polygon pieces, rebuild physical contact graph including existing plated through connections. No component-internal conductive paths are assumed. Signal nets have no zones. Conservative overestimate of surviving copper and underestimate of pad removal.
expected_content.mapping_change: U13 equivalent channel permutation ESC 1→3, RPM 3→6, SBUS 6→1; U12 and U14 unchanged. U15 bonded channels unchanged: IO1/pad1 RX and IO2/pad2 TX. External upstream routing lands only: NC10 RX and NC9 TX; IO3/IO4 and NC6/NC7 remain unused.
